description: Several years back former Pres. Obama took steps to bankrupt coal power plants via the unilateral creation of stringent new regulatory mandates. Gov. Dayton quickly adopted the crushing new mandates in MN, by-passing the MN Legislature resulting in Xcel Energy’s announcement to shut down two coal-fired generators at Sherco power plant in Becker earlier than planned.The Gov. Dayton influenced Public Utilities Commission endorsed shutting down the coal-fired units without naming replacement power
